new_text: When the driver is not deemed to be disengaged (as specified in paragraphs 5.5.4.2.4. and 5.5.4.2.5.) for more than 2 seconds immediately prior to its start, and (a) has commanded the system to perform the manoeuvre for a driver-initiated manoeuvre; or (b) has acknowledged the system's intention as needed for a driver-confirmed manoeuvre; or (c) is given sufficient notice to react for a system-initiated manoeuvre, the system shall initiate a manoeuvre, except that motoric disengagement may not be considered when HORs are being withheld by the system.
note: Adds 2 s time window and detection criteria reference; substantive.

new_text: When the driver is detected to be disengaged during a manoeuvre, the manufacturer shall describe in the safety concept the system behaviour (e.g., aborting the manoeuvre, fully executing a manoeuvre, bringing the vehicle to a safe stop).
note: Old para 5.3.7.2.4.3 moved here; only examples changed (risk mitigation function dropped, aborting added) and 'also' removed. Likely editorial/unchanged for a builder; our flag sits on 5.3.7.2.4.3 rather than this paragraph.

Sentence 'requirements of 5.5.4.1.8 shall apply' is gone from new text. Our flag calls it 'modified' with text referencing 6.2.9.1, which is NOT in the new text provided: wrong status and wrong text; should be removed.

new_text: The system shall be designed to ensure that the driver has sufficient time to confirm that the system may proceed with the manoeuvre, as appropriate.
note: Identical wording; our modified flag on R-024 looks like a false positive (should be unchanged).
7-second EOR lockout deleted; replaced by generic engagement strategies sentence.

new_text: The system shall implement strategies to ensure appropriate driver engagement prior to the initiation of the manoeuvre.
note: Old 5.3.7.2.4.2.1 content moved up; only 'In addition, further' dropped. Likely judged unchanged/editorial.

new_text: The strategies implemented to ensure appropriate driver engagement prior to the initiation of the manoeuvre shall be documented and explained.
note: Same as R-026: 'further' dropped only.
Paragraph deleted but obligation survives in 5.3.7.2.4.2; only a removed in the key if the builder fails to match them. Mutually exclusive with the modified/unchanged entry above.
Same as above.

Obligation relocated to 5.3.7.2.1.13, so not truly removed. New text here (justifiable reason + explain traffic situations) equals old R-029/R-030 from old 5.3.7.2.4.4, so it is unchanged, not added; our 'modified R-028' flag on this paragraph is likely a mis-anchor.
Highway-only/HOR restriction on initiating manoeuvres no longer present.

new_text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 5.3.7.2.1.1., when it is considered to mitigate the risk of an imminent collision, the system may initiate a system-initiated manoeuvre.
note: New exception.

new_text: Following completion of the manoeuvre and once the situation is controllable for the driver, a DCA shall be given.
note: New obligation; builder may merge with next one.

new_text: The system shall be disabled according to paragraph 5.5.4.2.8.
note: New obligation.

Driver-info acknowledgement request (stopped vehicle) not in this paragraph's new text; may be relocated elsewhere in the regulation (outside slice), which would make it unchanged. Our flags do not flag these removals: check the rest of the new text.
Monthly acknowledgement request; same relocation caveat.
Same.
Same.

new_text: Where the system-initiated manoeuvre is performed according to paragraph 5.3.7.2.4.10., the circumstances as to when this happens shall be described and justified to the Type Approval Authority.
note: New documentation obligation.

new_text: Where the system-initiated manoeuvre is performed according to paragraph 5.3.7.2.4.10., the circumstances as to when this happens shall be assessed according to Annex 3.
note: Builder split style (cf. R-052/R-053) makes a separate item likely.

new_text: While in highway or highway-like road operation, the system shall aim to respond to work zones, lane reductions, lane closures, toll stations and end of highways (e.g., by notifying the driver, issuing a DCA, or continuing operation if capable).
note: Scope broadened to highway-like roads.

Lane-marking recognition sentence (R-042) was fused into old text of this paragraph and is absent from new text here; probably still exists as its own paragraph 5.3.7.2.5.3, so likely unchanged. Rest of new text identical to old; non-highway response items unchanged (no add/modify).
